title: Primer contacto con SAP Business One

images.alt: Tres departamentos aislados a la izquierda y los mismos tres conectados a una base de datos central a la derecha
images.prompt: Split composition. Left half: three separate small islands, each with a tiny building icon (a shopping cart, a warehouse box, a coin stack), disconnected, with dotted question marks. Right half: the same three icons connected by clean arrows to one large central database cylinder. Concept: isolated departments versus one integrated company database.

images.alt: Cuatro engranajes conectados que representan ventas, almacén, finanzas y producción
images.prompt: Four interlocking gears in a row, each gear carrying one simple icon: a shopping cart, a delivery box, a stack of coins, a factory. Concept: all areas of a company turning together as one system.

images.alt: Una tienda pequeña con una laptop que muestra un tablero con gráficos
images.prompt: A small friendly business storefront with an awning, and in front of it a large laptop showing an abstract dashboard with bar chart, donut chart and a rising line. Concept: a small and medium business running on one integrated system.

images.alt: Dos empresas, cada una con su propia base de datos, y un usuario que alterna entre ellas
images.prompt: Two separate company buildings side by side, each connected to its own database cylinder below it. A user avatar in the middle with a double-headed swap arrow pointing to both buildings. Concept: one legal company equals one database, and the user switches between them.

images.alt: Un servidor con chip de memoria y rayo frente a un servidor con disco giratorio
images.prompt: Two server units side by side. Left server has a memory chip and a lightning bolt, suggesting in-memory speed. Right server has a spinning hard disk platter, suggesting disk-based storage. Neutral comparison, no winner marked.

images.alt: Un edificio con rack de servidores frente a una nube conectada a varios dispositivos
images.prompt: Left: an office building with a server rack inside and a padlock. Right: a large cloud connected by thin lines to a laptop, a tablet and a phone. Concept: on-premise versus cloud deployment.

images.alt: Esquema de una ventana de ERP con menú superior, barra de herramientas, menú lateral y área de trabajo resaltadas
images.prompt: A clean wireframe of a desktop application window with four zones highlighted in different flat colors: a top menu bar, a toolbar below it, a left navigation tree, and a large central workspace. Use only colored blocks and simple placeholder lines, no readable words.

images.alt: Una fila de iconos de herramientas, algunos en color y otros en gris
images.prompt: A horizontal toolbar with eight simple icons: filter, printer, spreadsheet, PDF page, magnifier, arrows, envelope, gear. Four are full color and four are greyed out. Concept: active versus unavailable functions.

images.alt: Un panel de mensajes con un triángulo de advertencia y un icono de error
images.prompt: A floating message panel with three rows: a warning triangle, an error circle with an exclamation mark, and a green check circle. Next to it a small magnifier. Concept: the system message log that helps find the cause of an issue.

images.alt: Una lupa grande sobre una pila de tarjetas de clientes, artículos y facturas
images.prompt: A large magnifying glass hovering over a fanned stack of document cards: a customer card with an avatar, an item card with a box, an invoice card with a coin. Concept: one global search across all records.

images.alt: Una ficha con una flecha naranja junto a un campo que lleva a otra ficha de datos maestros
images.prompt: A form card with a field row; next to the field a bright orange arrow button. A curved orange arrow leads from the button to a second card behind it showing a master record with an avatar. Concept: jump from a field straight to its master record.

images.alt: Una mano arrastra una etiqueta de cliente sobre un informe que se llena con sus datos
images.prompt: A hand cursor dragging a small customer badge across the screen toward a report panel. The panel on the right fills with filtered rows highlighted in blue. Concept: drag a code onto a report to get an instant filtered view.

images.alt: Cuatro fichas conectadas por flechas: oferta, pedido, entrega y factura
images.prompt: A horizontal flow of four rounded tiles connected by arrows. Tile icons: a quotation sheet, a clipboard order, a delivery truck, an invoice with a coin. Concept: a visual workbench of the sales flow.

images.alt: Un tablero con indicadores: número grande, medidor, gráfico de dona y semáforo
images.prompt: A tidy dashboard grid with six tiles: a big KPI tile with an upward arrow, a speedometer gauge, a donut chart, a bar chart, a traffic light with green yellow red, and a notification count bubble. No readable words.

images.alt: Una mano arrastra una ficha dentro de una cuadrícula y hay una papelera en la esquina
images.prompt: A grid of tiles with one tile being dragged by a hand cursor into an empty slot, and a small trash bin in the bottom right corner. A pencil icon at the top. Concept: customizing the cockpit by dragging widgets.

images.alt: Una tarjeta de identidad permanente que alimenta varios comprobantes de transacciones
images.prompt: On the left, one permanent ID card with an avatar and a lock. On the right, three different receipt-like transaction documents. Arrows from the ID card to each receipt. Concept: master data is permanent and feeds every document.

images.alt: Un documento que se copia al siguiente con las líneas ya cargadas, unido por una cadena
images.prompt: Two document sheets side by side joined by a chain link. The first has several filled lines; the second shows the same lines carried over with a glowing arrow between them. Concept: copy to the next document without retyping.

images.alt: Un árbol de documentos enlazados y un auditor con lupa
images.prompt: A small tree diagram of five document cards linked by chain connectors, branching from a quotation to an order to a delivery to an invoice to a payment. An auditor character with a magnifying glass inspects the chain.

images.alt: Un vendedor en su escritorio con una plantilla de cockpit y una llave de autorización
images.prompt: A salesperson avatar seated at a desk with a monitor showing a dashboard template. Beside the monitor a floating key and a shield with a check mark. Concept: assigning the right workspace and permissions to a new sales manager.

images.alt: Una cotización con líneas de texto, artículos, un subtotal y una insignia de descuento
images.prompt: A quotation sheet with distinct rows: one row of plain text lines, two item rows with small box icons, one highlighted subtotal bar, and a round percent badge at the bottom corner. No readable words or numbers.

images.alt: Cuatro caminos distintos que llegan a una lupa sobre una pila de pedidos abiertos
images.prompt: Four different colored paths (a link arrow, a drag hand, a list, a search bar) converging on one large magnifying glass over a stack of open order documents. Concept: four ways to audit open orders.
